name: flightdeck
description: A Flightdeck-style sidebar with the main session's vitals and every subagent working now, each as an outlined pixel progress bar with a stop button.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to stop Flightdeck drawing its sidebar and watching the session; /flightdeck then only says it is off.

recentActions.title: Recent actions shown
recentActions.description: How many of Claude's latest tool calls the Recent actions list shows, from 0 to 12. 0 hides the list. Default: 5.

recentFiles.title: Skills, plugins and MCPs shown
recentFiles.description: Set to 0 to hide the Skills, Plugins and MCPs lines. Any other value shows them. Default: 5.

showRepository.title: Show branch and memory lines
showRepository.description: Show the git branch line and Self Improve's memory line. Default: on.

gitSeconds.title: Git check interval (seconds)
gitSeconds.description: At most how often Flightdeck asks git for the branch and changed files, from 1 to 120. Default: 4.

agentCheckSeconds.title: Agent check interval (seconds)
agentCheckSeconds.description: How often the list of running subagents is checked against Claude Code while the sidebar is open, from 1 to 30. Default: 2.

reopenOnStart.title: Reopen at session start
reopenOnStart.description: Reopen the sidebar in a new session if it was left open last time. Default: on.
